open_issues.text: Skill instructions that tell a project to read SKM_HOME/SKM_WORKSPACES/SKM_WORKSPACE and to use the launcher are NOT inserted into any SKILL.md or generated instruction surface. Every candidate is hash/golden-gated and cannot be regenerated from this sandbox: the shell skill and any registered skill (packages/skiller/skills.json holds version, sha256 and content_sha256; the file is unreadable here), the maind managed template templates/skills/ecosystem-setup/SKILL.md (digest in tests/golden/generation.json, generated copies in .claude/skills and .agents/skills, .claude/skills is write-denied), and the harness instruction fragments (sha256 in catalog.json, rendered into CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md). Editing them would turn `skiller registry --check` and `golden.py check` red under V1. I reverted my draft of the shell-skill section. The canonical text is in docs/skm-environment.md (section 'What a skill or a project instruction says').

open_issues.text: Exporting SKM_HOME marks a machine as isolated: locations.machine_locations switches the lookup of the old XDG folders off and `config migrate-home` is refused under SKM_HOME. To avoid breaking a machine that has not migrated, planned_values leaves SKM_HOME out (with a note, also shown by the doctors) while Locations.legacy is non-empty and SKM_HOME is not already set. A machine that has migrated, or any new one, exports it.

open_issues.text: The goal names SKM_WORKSPACES for the workspaces folder, but the code and tests use SKM_WORKSPACES_ROOT everywhere (bridge env allowlists, scripts, vectors). I kept SKM_WORKSPACES_ROOT as the stronger, older name that is read first and never exported, and made SKM_WORKSPACES the exported name that is read when ROOT is unset (aicore, planner copy, two new shared vectors). The bridge manifests (gui.json, extension.json) still list only SKM_WORKSPACES_ROOT in their env allowlists, so a GUI-run workspace command does not see SKM_WORKSPACES.

open_issues.text: An exported SKM_WORKSPACE now wins over the workspace named by a project's marker in the workspace CLI (precedence in workspace/cli.py: --workspace, SKM_WORKSPACE, marker, the only workspace). With a single workspace this is the same; with several, a shell that exports workspace A and a checkout whose marker names B resolves to A. The snippet exports SKM_WORKSPACE only when there is exactly one workspace (or the shell already names one), and the doctor warns about a code that is not a workspace of the machine.

summary: SKM environment variables and shell export. New aicore.state.envtable (the one table: SKM_HOME, SKM_WORKSPACES, SKM_WORKSPACE; SKM_WORKSPACES_ROOT stays the older, stronger name of the workspaces folder) and aicore.state.shellenv (planned values, managed idempotent block in ~/.bashrc / ~/.zshrc where a value already in the environment wins, install/uninstall/inspect, doctor checks) with the command `aicore shell-env show|install|uninstall|doctor`. maind/skiller/root install.sh run the snippet install (--no-shell-env / SKM_NO_SHELL_ENV=1; a failure only warns; maind skips it when aicore is not found). project doctor and workspace doctor report env-snippet and env-variables. workspaces_root (aicore and the planner stdlib copy, with two new shared vectors) reads SKM_WORKSPACES after SKM_WORKSPACES_ROOT; plugin env allowlist passes the three names; harness hook libraries carry copies pinned to the table by a parity test. Test scripts of packages and bridges unset the three variables. Tests: new aicore tests/state/test_shellenv.py (44: table, values, install/uninstall idempotency, a fresh interactive bash, the command, doctors, the launcher with and without the variables), skiller and maind install tests, workspace test_doctor/test_cli, harness test_skm_env_table. Full aicore (OK) and workspace (OK after fixing test_cli) suites run, plus single files of harness, maind, skiller, planner. Docs: docs/skm-environment.md, project-launcher.md, workspace.md, READMEs, changelogs. NOT done: the skill instructions (see open_issues).
